newsitem.title: CHINA: Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle issues 230 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle issues 230 mln B shares.

text.p: Jinan Qingqi Montorcycle Co Ltd began issuing 230 million B shares today at a price of four yuan, equivalent to $0.482, per share for listing on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, a company statement in Thursday's Shanghai Securities News said.
The proceeds will be used to update technology, the statement said.
After the issue, the company will have total shares outstanding of 971.817 million, of which the B shares will account for 23.67 percent, it said.
The company has 37.619 million or 3.87 percent institutional shares and the remaining 40.90 percent are the state shares, the statement said.
